versions.content: API Function Header File Description Det _ Report - Runtime Error Det.h Service to report runtime errors. If a callout has been configured then this callout shall be called. Nm _ Bus Sleep - Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Bus - Sleep Mode. Nm _ Network - Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Network Mode. Nm _ Network - Start Indication Nm.h Notification that a NM - message has been received in the Bus - Sleep Mode, what indicates that some nodes in the network have already entered the Network Mode. Nm _ Prepare - Bus Sleep Mode Nm.h Notification that the network management has entered Prepar e Bus - Sleep Mode.
